name: chaos_checkout
description: Chaos Commerce checkout: prices the cart with absurd fees, argues with a payment gateway that always gives in (max 4 attempts), packs the parcels and confirms the order. Always completes.

inputParameters.queryExpression: {orderNumber: .opened.orderNumber, status: "CONFIRMED", customerName: .opened.customerName, greeting: .opened.greeting, lines: .pricing.lines, itemCount: .pricing.itemCount, subtotalCents: .pricing.subtotalCents, fees: .pricing.fees, feesCents: .pricing.feesCents, totalCents: .pricing.totalCents, payment: .payment, shipment: .shipment}
